name: Air-Fryer Vegetable Cutlets
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas), steamed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp chaat masala
steps: Mix all the ingredients except the oil to a firm mixture.
Shape into 8 oval cutlets and chill for 10 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C. Brush the cutlets lightly with oil.
Cook for 14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
note: Chickpeas and besan add protein to a snack that is usually mostly potato.
